question: The Second Five Year plan was based upon the ideas of which of the following statisticians?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis** was a renowned Indian **statistician**, often regarded as the father of modern statistics in India.
 
• The **Second Five-Year Plan** (1956-1961) in India was largely based on the **Mahalanobis Model**, which emphasized the growth of the **heavy industry sector**.
 
• The model sought to achieve a long-term economic strategy by prioritizing the development of industries like steel and machiner
